doctors.summary: Periodontist and implantologist with a fellowship in laser dentistry. She looks after gums, replaces missing teeth with implants and offers laser-assisted care alongside everyday dentistry.
bio: Dr. Aishwarya P leads Aishwarya Dental Clinic and Implant Centre in Vidyanagar, Guntur. Her master's degree (MDS) is in Periodontics and Implantology: the branch of dentistry that deals with the gums, the bone holding each tooth in place, and dental implants that replace teeth which have been lost.

She has also completed a fellowship in laser dentistry. Where a laser suits the problem, such as reshaping gums or treating gum pockets, it can mean less bleeding and a more comfortable recovery. She will tell you plainly when a conventional approach is the better choice.

Because so much of dentistry depends on healthy foundations, she begins every new patient's visit with a careful look at the gums and bone before planning fillings, root canals, aligners or a smile makeover. You leave with a written plan, the number of visits it usually takes and the cost, before any treatment begins.
